# PlacedChunk { #timetoalign.timelines.PlacedChunk }

```python
timelines.PlacedChunk(source, start)
```

A stretch of the root timeline, placed on the virtual axis.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name   | Type                                        | Description                                                  |
|--------|---------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------|
| source | [Interval](`timetoalign.core.Interval`)     | The stretch played, a half-open interval of the root's axis. |
| start  | [Coordinate](`timetoalign.core.Coordinate`) | Where it begins on the virtual axis.                         |
